name: Palisades State Park (King Campground)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-22: Esri World_Imagery (Minnehaha County orthos 2023-04-01) at 170 m half-width (0.38 m/px) over King's west row with every Go Outdoors SD facID=44 loop 201 unit plotted, plus an Esri Wayback green-season frame (release 2023-08-10, 0.43 m/px); both rendered. The nearest RV pads, the west row 32E-36E, end ~110-120 m from Split Rock Creek across open, mowed prairie (a narrow side slough ~55 m out); no site is near the water. The creek measures ~24-28 m of bed in the green-season frame and 29-40 m in the April 2023 snowmelt frame, so it reads as a creek, which has no view value -> not waterfront (stored value kept, re-measured for King alone after the Queen split; the old line measured from 43.6760,-96.5265, south of the loops).
inclusion_evidence: Go Outdoors SD engine https://reservations.gooutdoorssouthdakota.com/FacilityDetails.aspx?facID=44 (facilityName 'Palisades State Park'; gfp_facids.txt maps 44 to Palisades, 57 to Sandy Shore), sitesHashMap read 2026-11-22, loop 201 (King): 70 web-bookable electric RV sites 2E-71E, every one 'Back-In Campsite', 'Amp Service: 20,30, 50', UnitBasePrice $30; MaxEquipLength 80 on all but 34E (30); tent-only 72-77 ($16); camping cabins C1-C4 ($60); host V1 not sold online. GFP King Campground map https://gfp.sd.gov/userdocs/palisades_king_cg.pdf (2024-07-12): the same sites, Restroom/Shower by 57E, vault toilets, water, dump station on the entrance road. GFP page: 'In 2024 the park opened the new entrance ... 77 new campsites, a new dump station, 4 additional camping cabins'. Esri imagery 2026-11-22: gravel back-in pads at the unit points on the loops west of the entrance road from 256th St. Real drive-in RV campground; a 23-ft rig fits every RV site (shortest posted 30 ft, 34E). The Queen Campground (loop 125), 1,238 m away RV-site centroid to centroid, was split out 2026-11-22. Public (state): no price gate.
note: Palisades State Park's King Campground, the newer campground (opened 2024) on open prairie inside the park's 256th St entrance, 10 mi N of I-90 exit 406 near Garretson. The Sioux quartzite cliffs along Split Rock Creek, a kayak launch, the day-use area and hiking trails are nearby; climbers may use the cliffs but may not place bolts. The original Queen Campground, about 1.2 km north-east, is a separate entry. --Claude

sites.note: Plus tent-only sites 72-77 and camping cabins C1-C4.

season.note: October 1 to April 30 the showers, flush toilets and water may be off; vault toilets stay open.

sites.source: https://reservations.gooutdoorssouthdakota.com/FacilityDetails.aspx?facID=44 sitesHashMap, loop 201 (King), read 2026-11-22: 70 web-bookable RV sites 2E-71E, all 'Back-In Campsite'; MaxEquipLength 80 on 69 of them and 30 on 34E. The uniform 80 on every new pad reads as an engine default, so no max_rig_ft is written (the stored 84 was Queen's 111E); imagery shows long gravel back-ins. Host V1 excluded; tent-only 72-77; cabins C1-C4. GFP King map https://gfp.sd.gov/userdocs/palisades_king_cg.pdf (2024-07-12) shows the same sites.

hookups.source: https://reservations.gooutdoorssouthdakota.com/FacilityDetails.aspx?facID=44 sitesHashMap, loop 201 (King), read 2026-11-22: every web-bookable RV site 2E-71E 'Amp Service: 20,30, 50'. No water or sewer attribute on any unit.

_reasons: Queen Campground (engine loop 125, 22 RV sites) sits 1,238 m from King Campground (loop 201, 70 RV sites) RV-site centroid to centroid (nearest RV sites 2E and 108E-ADA 964 m), on its own road north from the day-use area; King's loops hang off the entrance road from 256th St. GFP: '2 campgrounds', separate King and Queen maps. Queen split out. Kept entry re-cut to King: name, pin moved 31 m to the RV-site centroid, elevation, waterfront evidence re-measured from King's pads, inclusion_evidence, note, sites (70, max length dropped as an engine default, no pull-thrus), hookups provenance, facilities provenance, season (GFP source replaces note-derived), booking provenance. facID 44 confirmed (website already carried it).
